description: This file defines interfaces, enums, macros, and function prototypes for the 'fsck' (file system check) subsystem in a Git-like version control system. It includes message types, error handling, walk functions, and object validation routines.

methods.name: fsck_set_msg_type_from_ids
methods.description: Sets the message type for a specific message ID in the fsck options.

methods.name: fsck_set_msg_type
methods.description: Sets the message type for a message identified by string IDs.

methods.name: fsck_set_msg_types
methods.description: Sets multiple message types based on a string input.

methods.name: is_valid_msg_type
methods.description: Checks if a given message ID and type are valid.

methods.name: fsck_walk
methods.description: Recursively walks through objects, applying a callback function.

methods.name: fsck_object
methods.description: Performs fsck checks on an object with provided data.

methods.name: fsck_buffer
methods.description: Performs fsck checks on raw data buffer for an object.

methods.name: fsck_tag_standalone
methods.description: Checks a tag object and returns info about it.

methods.name: fsck_has_queued_checks
methods.description: Returns whether there are remaining queued checks.

methods.name: fsck_options_clear
methods.description: Clears and frees resources in fsck options.

methods.name: fsck_report_ref
methods.description: Reports an error or warning related to refs.

methods.name: fsck_get_object_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an object by its ID.

methods.name: fsck_put_object_name
methods.description: Associates a name with an object ID.

methods.name: fsck_describe_object
methods.description: Returns a string describing an object with its name.
